steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Apply the setting whose effect on the saved draft is being tested.
Apply the additional configuration specified for this scenario.
Give the draft a searchable title.
Apply a pricing template before adding the line item.
Create the single line item needed for the Items 1 state.
Complete the pricing sheet so the draft can be saved.
Commit a valid schedule for the draft.
Create the saved eRFX draft under the configured setting.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the draft created by this plan.
Assert that the Items 1 control is not offered on the reopened draft.
